title: Shaman King
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yoh Asakura, a laid-back shaman from Izumo who can see and channel spirits, befriends classmate Manta and the ghost of a samurai, Amidamaru. Trained harshly by his fiancee Anna, Yoh enters the Shaman Fight, a tournament held every 500 years to choose the Shaman King who can merge with the Great Spirit and reshape the world. His chief rival is his twin Hao, a reincarnated shaman who plans to wipe out ordinary humans.
life_message: Strength of soul, friendship and an easygoing heart matter more than winning, and in the end fighting is no good.

content.note: Tournament battles throughout; Hao absorbs souls and plans human extinction (Wikipedia; AniList Necromancy, Super Power).
Ghosts, death and apocalyptic stakes; comic tone elsewhere.

winners_losers: Yoh and his friends prevail and Hao is persuaded to forgive humanity; zealotry and annihilation lose. Sympathy goes to gentleness and pluralism.
